question_text: How busy was the food court during lunch hours on average?
answer_text: Average headcount was 81.87 during lunch. This covers 3 lunch hours (hour_utc 11, 12, 13) with 10800.0 total_samples.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'food'
  AND toLower(ch.camera_location) CONTAINS 'court'
  AND toInteger(substring(ch.hour_utc, 11, 2)) IN [11,12,13]
WITH sum(toFloat(ch.avg_hc) * toFloat(ch.event_count)) AS weighted_sum,
     sum(toFloat(ch.event_count)) AS total_samples,
     count(*) AS lunch_hours_covered
RETURN CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN weighted_sum / total_samples ELSE null END AS avg_headcount, lunch_hours_covered, total_samples
